{"notes": "Visit 6 (left 8:00). Still no direct view of who placed what; ratings rest on the picture, claims and Jack's private note.

Picture: body, tail and both fin edges are dark and connected. About 4 pale dominoes remain as a stub inside the fin near (28.3-28.7, 9.8-10.4), loose end near (27,10). Hana and Jack both say about 153 of 157 fall and the outline is complete without the stub. The picture agrees, so I now treat the open gap as a small stub, not a break in the run. Earlier worry that the fin's right edge might not fall is mostly resolved. Risk is low, unverified until the push.

Jack: Spoke for the first time, privately. Said the stub was a deliberate choice, not to redo it late and risk breaking what works. That is a sound risk call, but it means the 'closing the last gap' claim from others was inaccurate. He owned the earlier bump near Omar and credited Omar and Sofia for the fin checking and fixing. Candid and accountable. His own placing is still unseen. Provisional: collaboration good, execution and impact unproven.

Omar: Accurate inspection earlier, kept clear of Jack's corner, agreed to hands off. Jack credits him with fin fixes, which fits. Reliable, collaborative, useful checker.

Hana: Accurate status, clear communication, called hands off. Execution unproven; she is mostly looking, not placing.

Sofia: Quiet this visit, agreed hands off. Earlier kept people on separate jobs and the body/tail gap got closed. Jack credits her with fixes. Steady leadership.

Next: watch the knock-over. Check whether the stub matters. Ask each person what they laid."}
